a.lede: Cybersecurity company Barracuda Networks warned that attackers have begun exploiting two recently patched Email Security Gateway (ESG) vulnerabilities that let them run commands with root privileges. [...]
a.title: Hackers now exploit critical Barracuda ESG flaws to gain root access

b.title: Google patches eighth Chrome zero-day exploited in attacks this year
